summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 29 条 X 动态、0 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 11 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues that the vast majority of enterprise workflows have not had agents applied in any meaningful way — likely under 1% deployed across the economy. At best, companies run a few single-pass LLM systems for decisions or feedback. He attributes this mostly to AI capability limits, which computer use, long-running agents, harness improvements and surrounding infrastructure are now removing. The shift, he says, is organizations re-engineering workflows around agents — self-improving systems and a…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，绝大多数企业工作流至今还没有真正用上 Agent，整体经济中的部署率可能不到 1%；现状最多是少量「单次调用 LLM 做判断或给反馈」的系统，谈不上真正的自动化。他认为主要瓶颈在于 AI 能力本身，而计算机使用（computer use）、长时运行 Agent、harness 改进和配套基础设施正在改变这一点。他的判断是：未来不是员工 prompt Agent 完成单个任务，而是组织围绕 Agent 重构底层工作流，借助自我改进系统和 Agent 集群（swarm）按需投入算力，金融、生命科学、医疗等信息密集行业影响最大。

featured.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
featured.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad offered an investment lens on frontier AI: he would underwrite it mostly on new discovery and its applications such as medicine, since coding and most knowledge work are quickly being saturated by sub-frontier models. He also joked that the judge in the piracy case against Anthropic, Alsup, sounds like "AI slop" when said fast, and shared a post on designers' contribution to the codebase.
featured.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 给前沿 AI 投资提了一个判断框架：如果他投前沿模型，会主要押注「新发现及其应用」（例如医药），因为编程和大部分知识工作正在被次前沿（sub-frontier）模型迅速饱和。另外他调侃了 Anthropic 版权案法官的名字 Alsup 读快了像「AI slop」，并转发了一张关于「设计师对代码库贡献」的图。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq, formerly on Claude Code at Anthropic, is experimenting with an AI-native macOS dock with custom modes (writing, building, etc.) to stay focused; his agent can customize mode behavior, add new modes, and classify his activity and notifications in real time to act on them. It's not shared yet due to edge cases. He also argued open source needs a new distribution model where people modify software via agents yet still get upstream changes merged automatically — coding agents can do it, just not automatically.
items.insightZh: 前 Claude Code 成员 Thariq 在做一个个人实验项目：AI 原生的 macOS Dock，带写作、构建等自定义模式帮助保持专注；他的 Agent 可以自行修改模式行为、新增模式，并实时分类他的活动和通知并据此行动。他强调还有很多边缘情况，暂不分享。另一条观点是：开源软件需要一种新的分发方式——用户可以通过 Agent 自由修改代码，同时还能自动合并上游更新；编码 Agent 做得到，但不会自动去做。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President Garry Tan shared how Capy's "software factory" has renormalized his GitHub contribution graph, with 10–20 subagents (Capy Captains) running at all times on GStack and GBrain and PRs flowing heavily. He added he's working to slim down GStack to reduce token usage and task latency.
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 晒出自己的 GitHub 贡献图，说用了 Capy 的「软件工厂」后颜色明显变深：他的 GStack 和 GBrain 项目上始终有 10–20 个子 Agent（Capy Captains）在并行跑，PR 产出密集。他同时表示正在给 GStack 瘦身，降低 token 消耗和任务延迟。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创始人
items.summaryEn: Swyx joked about his own "$500m bag fumble": while others posted about missing Cursor around the SpaceX IPO, he says he pitched something like Claude Code back in 2019 and then didn't build it for seven years — and as a TypeScript CLI maintainer, he likely would have been early.
items.insightZh: Swyx 自嘲了一次「错失 5 亿美元」：SpaceX IPO 时大家都在晒错过 Cursor 的经历，他说自己更惨——曾在 2019 年提出过类似 Claude Code 的东西，之后 7 年没去做；作为 TypeScript CLI 维护者，他估计自己本来很可能早早做到。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper predicts video creation and game making will become widely distributed foundations of knowledge work, the same way doc and deck creation are today, with more coming in Every this week.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 判断：视频制作和游戏制作将像今天的写文档、做 PPT 一样，成为知识工作中广泛普及的基础能力。他预告 Every 本周会有相关内容。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang listed hiring practices that need to change: filtering by years of experience or company names, prioritizing resumes over proof of work, treating headcount managed as an accomplishment, and endless interview rounds instead of short work trials. He also tried a not-yet-launched Grok bot feature he called one of his favorite and funniest AI moments, with a video coming soon.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 列出几条他认为该改的招聘做法：按工作年限或公司名筛人、看简历和求职信多于看真实项目、把「管了多少人」本身当成就、用无休止的面试轮次代替短期试岗。他还说试用了一个尚未全面上线的 Grok bot 功能，是近期和 AI 互动中最惊艳也最好笑的时刻之一，会专门做视频介绍。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark VC Matt Turck pushed back on the usual advice that too many co-founders is bad, noting Anthropic has 7 co-founders, OpenAI 11, and Databricks 7.
items.insightZh: FirstMark 合伙人 Matt Turck 反驳了「联合创始人太多不好」的常规创业建议：Anthropic 有 7 位联合创始人，OpenAI 有 11 位，Databricks 有 7 位。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari also pointed to Anthropic and Databricks (7 co-founders each) as proof that the best startups are outliers and there is no single right way to build. He listed terms like long horizon, out of distribution, intelligence per watt, RL environments, forward deployed, frontier and self improving, noting the surprising variance in how people define them.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 同样以 Anthropic 和 Databricks 各有 7 位联合创始人为例，认为顶级创业公司本就是离群值，不存在「正确」的建法，只有适合自己的方法。他还列出一批行业热词——long horizon、out of distribution、intelligence per watt、RL environments、forward deployed、frontier、self improving 等——说问 10 个人会得到 10 种差异极大的定义。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux posted that an update "has landed" (link only, no details in the text), then said it was done and teased "good news" tomorrow.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 发帖称某项更新「已落地」（帖内仅附链接，未写具体内容），随后表示「完成了，明天还有好消息」。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人
items.summaryEn: SPC General Partner and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal said he is very excited about what Cent AI Health is building, seeing big potential to bring better health to everyone in India.
items.insightZh: SPC 合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 表示非常看好 Cent AI Health 正在做的事情，认为它有很大潜力为印度所有人带来更好的医疗健康。
